name: octolens
description: Octolens social listening for coding agents: search what people say about a brand, fetch and triage mentions, manage keywords, feeds and Slack/email/webhook alerts, and run analytics across Reddit, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Hacker News, GitHub and more. Bundles the Octolens skill (CLI + REST API v2) and the hosted Octolens MCP server (OAuth sign-in).

interface.shortDescription: Social listening: brand mentions, keywords, alerts and analytics
interface.longDescription: Octolens monitors Reddit, X, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Bluesky, Hacker News, GitHub, news, podcasts and the open web for your keywords, and AI-scores every mention for relevance and sentiment. This plugin adds the Octolens skill (the octolens CLI and REST API v2) and the hosted Octolens MCP server, so the agent can search mentions, triage them, manage keywords, feeds and alerts, and answer analytics questions about your workspace.
defaultPrompt: What are people saying about our brand this week? Summarize the most relevant mentions.
Show me negative mentions from Reddit in the last 7 days.
Add a keyword for our main competitor and alert #marketing in Slack on new mentions.
